prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW battle-action sprite sheet for the EXACT upgraded Brasshollow creature shown in the reference image. Reference is identity/design/style ONLY, not desired poses. Preserve the SAME armor silhouette, face/mask, equipment, proportions, painterly weathered brass/iron finish, right-facing three-quarter camera and body scale. Actual new articulated paintings, NOT shifted/rotated existing cutouts. TRUE transparent RGBA background. Exactly FOUR distinct poses in a regular2x2 grid, row-major: top-left ATTACK WINDUP; top-right ATTACK IMPACT/RELEASE; bottom-left HIT RECOIL; bottom-right FALLEN/DEAD. No captions/text. Sheet1536x1536, each cell768x768, generous100px transparent margin per cell. Entire weapons, all body parts, whole horizontal fallen body within each cell. Shrink all figures equally if necessary to fit longest pose. No grid, scenery, ground tile, base, cast ground shadow, gore or external effects clouds. Same character equipment count in all cells. Hit pose visibly bends/recoils with weapons still held. Fallen pose MUST show creature lying collapsed on its side on the ground, not crouching/standing: horizontal torso, bent limbs, gear fallen beside body but fully in frame. Twinboiler Fusilier. Windup both elbows draw multi-nozzle rivet gun backward at waist, torso twists; release arms brace the same gun straight right near chest with no external projectiles; hit torso recoils, knees buckle and nozzle dips. Fallen machine-armored fusilier lies fully on its side, twin round boilers attached and gun beside body, all pipes and three nozzles intact. All poses weapons remain below helmet height. Important: Keep full upper silhouette at or BELOW reference idle head height. Attacks extend horizontally, not overhead. Wide empty gutters.
reference_use: Accepted upgraded idle sheet supplied as identity and style reference. Original articulated action poses.
